englishDescription: By rapidly rolling its legs, it can travel at over 18 mph. The temperature of the flames it breathes exceeds 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.
chineseDescription: 由于内部在制造煤焦油，因此就算它跑得再快，背上的煤炭山也不会崩塌。
japaneseDescription: 脚を 高速で 回転させて 時速３０キロで 走る。 摂氏 １０００度の 炎を 噴き出す。

englishDescription: While it’s engaged in battle, its mountain of coal will burn bright red, sending off sparks that scorch the surrounding area.
chineseDescription: 性情温厚，发怒时却十分可怕。它会用燃烧到１５００度的躯体压住对手，将其烧成灰烬。
japaneseDescription: 戦いになると 石炭の 山が 真っ赤に 燃え上がり 火の粉を まき散らして 周囲を 焦がす。

englishDescription: As soon as it’s born, it burrows into an apple. Not only does the apple serve as its food source, but the flavor of the fruit determines its evolution.
chineseDescription: 平时生活在苹果中。如果失去了苹果，身体的水分就会流失，从而逐渐虚弱。
japaneseDescription: 生まれると りんごに 潜りこむ。 中身を 食べながら 成長し りんごの 味が 進化を 決める。
japaneseGenus: りんごぐらしポケモン

englishDescription: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.
chineseDescription: 会用体液修补苹果。身经百战的强者的苹果会整体呈现出黏土色。
japaneseDescription: りんごの 皮の 翼で 飛んで 強酸性の 唾液を 飛ばす。 りんごの 形に 変形する。

englishDescription: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.
chineseDescription: 当有爱吃豚来舔食自己背上的甜甜蜜时，会吐出黏糊糊的蜜汁来将其击退。
japaneseDescription: 甘い 蜜で 体が おおわれ 背中の 皮は とくに 甘く 昔は 子どもの おやつだった。

englishDescription: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.
chineseDescription: 它大大的鼻孔是专门为了喷射沙子而特别进化的，因此很不擅长分辨气味。
japaneseDescription: 鼻の 穴から 砂を 噴射。 敵の 目を くらました 隙に 地中に 潜って 身を 隠す。

englishDescription: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.
chineseDescription: 喷出的沙子里混着尖锐的沙砾，那是它用唾液凝固了沙子而成的，形状千奇百怪。
japaneseDescription: 独特の とぐろの 巻き方は 砂袋の 砂を より 効率 よく 噴射 するため なのだ。

englishDescription: This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow a Pokémon other than its preferred prey.
chineseDescription: 记性相当差，会把大部分能量分配在战斗上，只留最低限度的能量给大脑。利用卡在喉咙中的刺梭鱼活蹦乱跳的力量将其高速吐出。（一口吞的样子）借助卡在喉咙中的皮卡丘酥酥麻麻的电力让对手触电。（大口吞的样子）
japaneseDescription: 食いしん坊で エサの サシカマスを 丸飲みするが たまに 間違えて ほかの ポケモンに 食らいつく。

englishDescription: After it’s eaten its fill, its movements become extremely sluggish. That’s when Cramorant swallows it up.
chineseDescription: 会用又硬又尖的下巴发动突击捕杀猎物。视力很差，因此成功率很低。
japaneseDescription: 腹一杯で 極端に 動きが 鈍った ところを ウッウに 丸飲みに される。

englishDescription: It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging forward at speeds of over 100 knots before ramming prey and spearing into them.
chineseDescription: 以超过１００节的速度游泳。会为了争夺食物和波普海豚的群体展开激烈的斗争。
japaneseDescription: 尾びれを 回転させ 一気に 突撃。 １００ノットを 超える 速度で 獲物を つらぬくぞ。

englishDescription: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it can cause a tingling paralysis.
chineseDescription: 通过让自身的毒素产生化学反应来发电。电力虽然弱，却能造成麻痹。
japaneseDescription: 毒素を 化学変化 させて 電気を 出す。 電力は 弱いが ビリビリと 痺れる。

englishDescription: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.
chineseDescription: 当它用力抓挠胸部的突起物来制造电力时，四周会响起如同吉他演奏般的声音。（高调的样子）发电器官长在胸部。当它制造出电力的时候，会发出贝斯般的声音。（低调的样子）
japaneseDescription: ケンカ腰で 気が 短い。 よどんだ 水を がぶ飲みして 水中の 毒素を 取りこむ。

englishDescription: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they’re well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.
chineseDescription: 会用滚烫的身体勒紧猎物，等到烤得恰到好处之时，就把它们大口大口地吃掉。
japaneseDescription: 発熱した 体で 獲物を 締め上げる。 こんがり 焼けたら むしゃむしゃ いただくのだ。

englishDescription: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.
chineseDescription: 性格极具攻击性。危险的不只是它烧烫的身体，大大的獠牙也锐利无比。超极巨化的焚焰蚣释放出的热辐射会扰乱气流，有时甚至还会引发暴风雨。（超极巨化）
japaneseDescription: 攻撃的な 性質。 焼けた 体も 危険だが 大きな キバも 鋭いぞ。

englishDescription: Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn’t alarmed when that happens—it knows they’ll grow back. It’s about as smart as a three-year-old.
chineseDescription: 触手前端鼓鼓的，很擅长一个劲地敲打，但极不擅长抓取东西。
japaneseDescription: ３歳児 くらいの 賢さ。 触手は よくちぎれるが 再生するので 気にしない。

englishDescription: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.
chineseDescription: 会用自豪的触手施展寝技压制对手。即便力量惊人的宝可梦也无法挣脱并逃走。
japaneseDescription: おのれの腕を 試すべく 陸に 上がり 対戦相手を 探す。 戦い終えると 海に 帰る。
japaneseGenus: じゅうじゅつポケモン

englishDescription: The teacup in which this Pokémon makes its home is a famous piece of antique tableware. Many forgeries are in circulation.
chineseDescription: 趁着自己被喝掉时进入对方身体里，从内部夺走对方的生物能量。味道很糟糕。（赝品形态）住在古董茶杯里的样子。虽然十分贵重，但来悲茶还是一如既往地不好喝。（真品形态）
japaneseDescription: すみかに している ティーカップは 有名な アンティークの 食器。 多くの 贋作が 出回っている。

englishDescription: Leaving leftover black tea unattended is asking for this Pokémon to come along and pour itself into it, turning the tea into a new Polteageist.
chineseDescription: 会潜入茶壶里，然后把自己倒进喝到一半的红茶里来增加份量。（赝品形态）虽然喝下它会有危险，但味道很好。不怕危险的美食家们每天都喝怖思壶。（真品形态）
japaneseDescription: 残された 紅茶を 見かけると 自分の 体を 注ぎこむ。 その 紅茶は ポットデスになる。

englishDescription: If this Pokémon senses a strong emotion, it will run away as fast as it can. It prefers areas without people.
chineseDescription: 能够捕捉生物的心情。如果持续接收强烈的情感就会累坏，因此要当心。
japaneseDescription: 人気の ない 場所が 好き。 強い 感情を 感じとると 一目散に 逃げ出してしまう。

englishDescription: Using the braids on its head, it pummels foes to get them to quiet down. One blow from those braids would knock out a professional boxer.
chineseDescription: 一旦发现了情绪激昂的对象，就会用辫子毒打，直到对方失去意识而沉默下来为止。
japaneseDescription: 頭の房で 相手を 殴り 黙らせる。 プロボクサーさえ 一発 ＫＯの 破壊力。

englishDescription: If you’re too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle. This Pokémon is also known as the Forest Witch.
chineseDescription: 要小心没有任何生物气息的森林，因为那代表你可能进入了布莉姆温的地盘。
japaneseDescription: 別名は 森の 魔女。 騒ぎたてると 触手のツメで 引き裂かれるかも しれないぞ。

englishDescription: It sneaks into people’s homes, stealing things and feasting on the negative energy of the frustrated occupants.
chineseDescription: 成群结队地生活。彼此之间会恶作剧和找不痛快，以此来磨炼制造麻烦的技能。
japaneseDescription: 民家に 忍びこみ 盗みを 働き さらに 悔しがる 人の マイナスエネルギーも いただくのだ。

englishDescription: With sly cunning, it tries to lure people into the woods. Some believe it to have the power to make crops grow.
chineseDescription: 吸收负面情绪来转换成自身能量的宝可梦。思考方式消极的人群很喜欢它。
japaneseDescription: 悪知恵を 使って 夜の 森に 誘い込もうとする。 農作物を 育てる 力を もつらしい。

englishDescription: Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairs unfurl, they latch on to opponents, ensnaring them as tentacles would.
chineseDescription: 生活在森林深处。即使进化后变得挺拔强壮，还是会继续做无聊的坏事和恶作剧。
japaneseDescription: 髪の毛は 筋肉繊維の ように 働き ほどけると 触手の 動きで 相手を 絡めとる。
japaneseGenus: ビルドアップポケモン

englishDescription: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.
chineseDescription: 在不断的斗争中得到了进化。它交叉着双臂发出的怒吼能让一切对手都为之胆怯。
japaneseDescription: ケンカを 繰り返し 進化。 腕をクロスし 叫ぶ 雄叫びは どんな 相手も 怯ませるぞ。

englishDescription: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.
chineseDescription: 战斗中的实力无与伦比，留下了无数的英勇事迹，但栖身之处却堆满垃圾。
japaneseDescription: 戦いに 明け暮れて 進化した 結果 伸ばすと 短剣に 変わる 物騒な ツメを 手に入れた。

englishDescription: Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body surrounding its soul. You’ll become stiff as stone if you touch it.
chineseDescription: 一定要小心它那包覆着灵魂的灵体。如果触摸到，就会像石头一样动弹不得。
japaneseDescription: 魂を 被う 霊体の 体には 注意。 触れると 石のように 動けなく なるぞ。

englishDescription: After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk. The leek stalk is both weapon and food.
chineseDescription: 对于葱游兵来说，倾注心血培育的葱比任何事物都重要。以华丽的葱术在战场上立功。
japaneseDescription: 硬いネギの 葉で 攻撃を いなし 鋭い 茎で 反撃。 ネギは 武具であり 食材。

englishDescription: Its amusing movements make it very popular. It releases its psychic power from the pattern on its belly.
chineseDescription: 滑稽的舞步是它的绝学。会趁着敌方大笑之际，施以零下２００度的冷气。
japaneseDescription: ユーモラスな 動きで みんなの 人気者。 お腹の 模様から サイコパワーを 放出する。
japaneseGenus: コメディアンポケモン

englishDescription: Never touch its shadowlike body, or you’ll be shown the horrific memories behind the picture carved into it.
chineseDescription: 由于曾支离破碎的黏土板完全复原了，封印其中的怨念的能量随之全面释放。
japaneseDescription: 影の ような 体に 触れては いけない。 絵に 刻まれた 恐ろしい 記憶を 見せられるぞ。

englishDescription: They say that any patisserie visited by Milcery is guaranteed success and good fortune.
chineseDescription: 遭到敌人袭击时会使出撞击，或是令敌人沾满奶油而封住视线，或是趁敌人惊叹美味时逃之夭夭。
japaneseDescription: マホミルが 姿を みせた パティスリーは 大繁盛が 約束されると いわれている。

englishDescription: When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.
chineseDescription: 备受照料的霜奶仙产出的鲜奶油可谓极品，因此训练家都会温柔地培育它。（奶香香草）一旦遭到敌人袭击，就会投掷突出了酸甜风味的鲜奶油进行反击。（奶香红钻）一旦遭到敌人袭击，就会投掷突出了芳香风味的鲜奶油进行反击。（奶香抹茶）一旦遭到敌人袭击，就会投掷突出了清爽风味的鲜奶油进行反击。（奶香薄荷）一旦遭到敌人袭击，就会投掷突出了酸酸风味的鲜奶油进行反击。（奶香柠檬）一旦遭到敌人袭击，就会投掷突出了咸咸风味的鲜奶油进行反击。（奶香雪盐）一旦遭到敌人袭击，就会投掷突出了缤纷风味的鲜奶油进行反击。（红钻综合）一旦遭到敌人袭击，就会投掷突出了偏苦风味的鲜奶油进行反击。（焦糖综合）一旦遭到敌人袭击，就会投掷突出了复杂风味的鲜奶油进行反击。（三色综合）
japaneseDescription: 手から 生みだす クリームは マホイップが 幸せなとき 甘味と コクが 深まる。

englishDescription: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.
chineseDescription: 列阵兵由１个头头和５个跟班组成。头头的命令不可违抗。仅限拥有牢固牵绊的头头和跟班才能组成的究极阵形。（超级进化）
japaneseDescription: ６匹で １匹の ポケモン。 隊列を 組み替えながら チームワークで 戦うのだ。

englishDescription: It stores electricity in each spine. Even if one gets broken off, it still continues to emit electricity for at least three hours.
chineseDescription: 性情胆小，光是碰到碎藻就能让它吓到放电。嘴唇不会导电。
japaneseDescription: 棘の １本 １本に 電気を 蓄える。 折れた 棘でも ３時間は 放電を 続けるぞ。

englishDescription: It eats snow that piles up on the ground. The more snow it eats, the bigger and more impressive the spikes on its back grow.
chineseDescription: 会吃掉雪来获得寒气，并利用体内的器官加强冰冷的程度，以此来制作如冰柱般的尖刺。
japaneseDescription: 地面に 積もった 雪を 食べる。 たくさん 食べれば 食べるほど 背中の 棘は 立派に 育つ。

englishDescription: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.
chineseDescription: 会用能释放寒气的巨大翅膀飞来飞去，引发暴风雪。喜欢干净的雪融水。
japaneseDescription: 野山を 荒らすものには 容赦 しない。 冷たいはねで 飛びまわり 吹雪を 起こして 懲らしめる。

englishDescription: Once a year, on a specific date and at a specific time, they gather out of nowhere and form up in a circle.
chineseDescription: 每天眺望着日升日落。会用超过２００公斤的双脚悠然自得地在草原上阔步。
japaneseDescription: １年に 一度 きまった 日時に どこから ともなく 集まり 輪に なって 並ぶ 習性が ある。

englishDescription: This Pokémon keeps its heat-sensitive head cool with ice. It fishes for its food, dangling its single hair into the sea to lure in prey.
chineseDescription: 脸部的冰块舔起来略带咸味。它是乘着海流从遥远的寒冷地带来到这里的。（结冻头）与外表相反，不擅长游泳。在发梢做出冰球来吸引并钓起猎物。（解冻头）
japaneseDescription: 暑さに 弱い 顔を いつも 氷で 冷やしている。 頭の 毛を 海に たらして 餌を釣る。

englishDescription: Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the source of its strength.
chineseDescription: 能通过自己的角去感受附近生物的情感。正面情绪是它的能量之源。（雄性的样子）拥有高度智能的宝可梦。能通过伙伴间角与角的互碰来彼此交换信息。（雌性的样子）
japaneseDescription: ツノで 近くの 生き物の 気持ちを 感じとる。 ポジティブな 感情が 力の 源。

englishDescription: It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if they’re precious treasures. No matter how much it eats, it always gets hungry again in short order.
chineseDescription: 总是饿着肚子。会吃掉装在像口袋一样的袋子里的种子来发电。（满腹花纹）颊囊中的电能转化成了恶属性的能量。因为肚子饿扁了，所以非常凶暴。（空腹花纹）
japaneseDescription: どんなに 食べても すぐに お腹が すく。 電気で ローストした タネを 大切に 持ち歩く。

englishDescription: If a job requires serious strength, this Pokémon will excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in the rain, turning a vibrant green color.
chineseDescription: 能够举起５吨的货物。天一亮就会成群结队地去洞窟找矿石来吃。
japaneseDescription: 力仕事なら お任せ。 銅の 体は 雨で 錆び 鮮やかな 緑に 変わる。

englishDescription: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.
chineseDescription: 自尊心强，脾气刁钻。绿色的皮肤越是鲜艳，就越受到同伴的尊敬。
japaneseDescription: 群れを つくって 暮らしている。 鼻の 握力は 大岩も 粉々に 砕くほど 強い。

englishDescription: The powerful muscles in its tail generate its electricity. Compared to its lower body, its upper half is entirely too small.
chineseDescription: 会用尾部结实的肌肉发电。与下半身相比，上半身真的太小了。
japaneseDescription: しっぽの たくましい 筋肉で 発電する。 下半身に くらべ 上半身が 小さすぎる。

englishDescription: This Pokémon lived on prehistoric seashores and was able to preserve food with the ice on its body. It went extinct because it moved so slowly.
chineseDescription: 曾经生活在古代的海边，能用身体的冰来保存食物，但由于动作太迟缓而灭绝了。
japaneseDescription: 古代の 海辺で 暮らし 餌を 体の 氷で 保存できたが 動きが 鈍いため 絶滅した。

englishDescription: Its mighty legs are capable of running at speeds exceeding 40 mph, but this Pokémon can’t breathe unless it’s underwater.
chineseDescription: 虽然能用自豪的脚力以６０公里的时速奔跑，但是只能在水中呼吸。
japaneseDescription: 時速６０キロを 超える 自慢の 脚力で 走れるが 水中でしか 呼吸できない。

englishDescription: The skin on its face is impervious to attack, but breathing difficulties made this Pokémon go extinct anyway.
chineseDescription: 面部的皮肤无论受到什么攻击都不会受伤，但由于呼吸起来不方便而灭绝了。
japaneseDescription: どんな 攻撃にも 傷つかない 面の皮を もつが 呼吸が 不自由だったため 絶滅した。

englishDescription: The special metal that composes its body is very light, so this Pokémon has considerable agility. It lives in caves because it dislikes the rain.
chineseDescription: 金属的身体虽然坚固，但由于会封闭热量，因此会从尾巴缝隙排热。
japaneseDescription: 特殊な 金属の 体は 軽く 身のこなしは 抜群。 雨が 苦手で 洞窟に 棲む。

englishDescription: If this weak Pokémon is by itself, a mere child could defeat it. But if Dreepy has friends to help it train, it can evolve and become much stronger.
chineseDescription: 明明不吃却又会咬住铁臂枪虾不放。听说这是它生前遗留下来的活动习性。
japaneseDescription: １匹では 子どもにも 負けるくらい 非力だが 仲間の 協力で 鍛えられ 進化して 強くなる。

englishDescription: Without a Dreepy to place on its head and care for, it gets so uneasy it’ll try to substitute any Pokémon it finds for the missing Dreepy.
chineseDescription: 会在肺部储存能量并进行攻击。在多龙梅西亚能独当一面之前，会和它一起战斗并照顾它。
japaneseDescription: 世話をする ドラメシヤを 頭に 乗せていないと 落ち着かないので ほかの ポケモンを 乗せようとする。

englishDescription: Apparently the Dreepy inside Dragapult’s horns eagerly look forward to being launched out at Mach speeds.
chineseDescription: 群体里飞得最快的个体总是被想要体验音速飞行的多龙梅西亚包围。
japaneseDescription: ツノに 入った ドラメシヤは マッハの スピードで 飛ばされるのを 心待ちに しているらしい。

englishDescription: This Pokémon has slumbered for many years. Some say it’s Zamazenta’s elder sister—others say the two Pokémon are rivals.
chineseDescription: 这只宝可梦被认为是沉睡已久的藏玛然特的姐姐，也有人认为它们之间是劲敌关系。（百战勇者）能斩断世间万物，因此被称为妖精王之剑，让敌友都对其敬畏不已。（剑之王）
japaneseDescription: 長い 眠りに ついていた ザマゼンタの 姉 とも ライバルとも いわれる ポケモン。

englishDescription: This Pokémon slept for aeons while in the form of a statue. It was asleep for so long, people forgot that it ever existed.
chineseDescription: 以石像般的姿态陷入长久沉眠的宝可梦。几乎就要被人们所遗忘。（百战勇者）全副武装的样子。即使是极巨化宝可梦的攻击也能轻易抵挡。（盾之王）
japaneseDescription: 石像の ような 姿で 忘れ去られるほどの あいだ 眠りに ついていた ポケモン。

englishDescription: It was inside a meteorite that fell 20,000 years ago. There seems to be a connection between this Pokémon and the Dynamax phenomenon.
chineseDescription: 来自于２万年前坠落到地上的陨石之中。似乎与极巨化之谜有所关联。巨大化的核心释放出无限的能量，扭曲了周围的时空。（无极巨化）
japaneseDescription: ２万年前に 落ちた 隕石の 中に いた。 ダイマックスの 謎に 関係している らしい。

englishDescription: If Kubfu pulls the long white hair on its head, its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up from the depths of its belly.
chineseDescription: 拉紧头上又白又长的体毛，就会变得斗气势高昂，并从丹田涌出力量。
japaneseDescription: 頭の 白く 長い 体毛を 引っぱると 気合が 高まり 丹田から パワーが 湧きあがる。

englishDescription: Inhabiting the mountains of a distant region, this Pokémon races across sheer cliffs, training its legs and refining its moves.
chineseDescription: 生活在遥远地区的山岳地带。通过在断崖绝壁上奔跑来锻炼腰腿，磨炼招式。（一击流）把多击制胜作为自己的信条。会像水流一样毫不停息地用打击招式攻击对手。（连击流）从拳头放出的能量变成了冲击波，能一击打飞极巨化的宝可梦。（一击流超极巨化）据说内心邪恶的家伙只是被它暗藏愤怒的眼睛瞪着就会一命呜呼。（连击流超极巨化）
japaneseDescription: 遠い 地方の 山岳地帯で 暮らす。 断崖絶壁を 走り 足腰を 鍛え 技を 磨く。

englishDescription: Once the vines on Zarude’s body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.
chineseDescription: 长在身上的藤蔓断掉之后会变成土壤的养分，帮助森林中的植物成长。对于由自己捡来并抚养长大的人类小孩怀有深厚的感情。这份感情带给它一种特别的力量。（阿爸）
japaneseDescription: 体に 生える ツルは ちぎれると 土の 栄養分となって 森の 植物たちを 育てるのだ。

englishDescription: Its entire body is made up of a single organ that generates electrical energy. Regieleki is capable of creating all Galar’s electricity.
chineseDescription: 整个身体是制造电能的器官。可以制造出伽勒尔全域所需的电力。
japaneseDescription: 全身が 電気エネルギーを 作る 器官。 ガラル全土の 電気を 作りだすことができる。
japaneseGenus: エレクトロンポケモン

englishDescription: Its body is composed of crystallized dragon energy. Regidrago is said to have the powers of every dragon Pokémon.
chineseDescription: 整个身体是龙之能量的结晶。据说它拥有所有龙宝可梦的能力。
japaneseDescription: 全身が ドラゴンエネルギーの 結晶。 すべての ドラゴン ポケモンの 力を 持つらしい。
japaneseGenus: りゅうぎょくポケモン

englishDescription: Glastrier has tremendous physical strength, and the mask of ice covering its face is 100 times harder than diamond.
chineseDescription: 拥有十分惊人的怪力。戴在脸上的冰之面罩硬度是钻石的１００倍。
japaneseDescription: 凄まじい 怪力の 持ち主。 顔を 覆う 氷の マスクは ダイヤモンドの １００倍 硬い。

englishDescription: As it dashes through the night, Spectrier absorbs the life-force of sleeping creatures. It craves silence and solitude.
chineseDescription: 在黑暗的夜晚中奔跑，吸取正在睡觉的生物的生命能量。喜欢孤独和静寂。
japaneseDescription: 闇夜を 駆けぬけ 寝ているものの 生命エネルギーを 吸い取る。 孤独と 静寂を 好む。

englishDescription: Calyrex is known in legend as a king that ruled over Galar in ancient times. It has the power to cause hearts to mend and plants to spring forth.
chineseDescription: 曾经在很久以前统治着伽勒尔的传说之王。拥有治愈心灵和让草木发芽的能力。据说它用一个晚上把广阔的森林和栖息在其中的生物转移到了其他的地方。（骑白马的样子） 据说它用能够看透过去与未来所有事件的能力从陨石掉落的危机中拯救了森林中的生物。（骑黑马的样子）
japaneseDescription: 大昔の ガラルを 統べていた 伝説の 王。 心を 癒し 草木を 芽吹かせる 力がある。

englishDescription: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.
chineseDescription: 制造肉眼不可见的障壁时，黑珠会发出妖异的光辉。从它身上脱落的胡须是用来制作温暖冬衣的实用原料。
japaneseDescription: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.

englishDescription: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.
chineseDescription: 岩石斧头会在激烈的战斗中到处出现缺损，但也因此变得愈发锋利。
japaneseDescription: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.

englishDescription: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.
chineseDescription: 很特别的月月熊，会用如铁般坚硬的泥土保护身体，并拥有能看穿黑暗的左眼。（赫月）
japaneseDescription: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.

englishDescription: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.
chineseDescription: 拥有惊人的弹跳力。死去的伙伴的怒火染红了它的身体。（雄性的样子）能操控恐怖的幻觉。伙伴的灵魂的悲痛越深，它的身体就会变得越白。（雌性的样子）
japaneseDescription: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.

englishDescription: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.
chineseDescription: 拥有凌驾其他物种之上的身体能力以及剧毒。在寒冷的高地上所向无敌。偏好独自行动，而不会集结成群。
japaneseDescription: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.
japaneseGenus: クライミングポケモン

englishDescription: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname ”sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.
chineseDescription: 强化得又粗又长的毒针能够自行针对会动的东西发起攻击。
japaneseDescription: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname ”sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.

englishDescription: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.
chineseDescription: 当它越过大海飞来，便代表严寒的冬季即将终结。传说中其慈爱将使新的生命在洗翠大地上萌芽。（化身形态）自女人的姿态变化而成。若有谁做出糟蹋生命之事，便会从云海中现身，愤怒地降下无情的惩罚。（灵兽形态）
japaneseDescription: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.

englishDescription: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.
chineseDescription: 通过身体发出的甜甜香气来让周围的一切为之倾倒。晒到阳光后香气会更加浓郁。
japaneseDescription: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.

englishDescription: The hardness of Floragato’s fur depends on the Pokémon’s mood. When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.
chineseDescription: 体毛的硬度随心情而变。进入迎战状态时，体毛会变得如针一般尖锐。
japaneseDescription: The hardness of Floragato’s fur depends on the Pokémon’s mood. When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.

englishDescription: With skillful misdirection, it rigs foes with pollen-packed flower bombs. Meowscarada sets off the bombs before its foes realize what’s going on.
chineseDescription: 会巧妙地引开敌人的注意力，然后引爆它在神不知鬼不觉间设置好的装满花粉的花炸弹。
japaneseDescription: With skillful misdirection, it rigs foes with pollen-packed flower bombs. Meowscarada sets off the bombs before its foes realize what’s going on.

englishDescription: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco’s head and flickers to and fro.
chineseDescription: 火囊很小，因此能量会从头部的凹陷处溢出来，并摇曳晃动着。
japaneseDescription: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco’s head and flickers to and fro.

englishDescription: The valve in Crocalor’s flame sac is closely connected to its vocal cords. This Pokémon utters a guttural cry as it spews flames every which way.
chineseDescription: 声带和火囊的阀紧邻在一起。会一边发出嘶哑的声音，一边喷洒火焰。
japaneseDescription: The valve in Crocalor’s flame sac is closely connected to its vocal cords. This Pokémon utters a guttural cry as it spews flames every which way.

englishDescription: Skeledirge’s gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.
chineseDescription: 温柔的歌声能治愈听者的灵魂。会使用３０００度的火焰将敌人烧成灰烬。
japaneseDescription: Skeledirge’s gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.

englishDescription: Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.
chineseDescription: 脚力之强，即使在水流湍急的河川也能自在游动。爱干净，性格有些顽固。
japaneseDescription: Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.

englishDescription: The hardworking Quaxwell observes people and Pokémon from various regions and incorporates their movements into its own dance routines.
chineseDescription: 性情勤奋。会观察各个地区的人和宝可梦的动作来吸取到自己的舞蹈里。
japaneseDescription: The hardworking Quaxwell observes people and Pokémon from various regions and incorporates their movements into its own dance routines.

englishDescription: Dancing in ways that evoke far-away places, this Pokémon mesmerizes all that see it. Flourishes of its decorative water feathers slice into its foes.
chineseDescription: 会用充满异国风情的舞蹈来迷倒看者，然后挥舞以水构成的羽饰将其劈裂。
japaneseDescription: Dancing in ways that evoke far-away places, this Pokémon mesmerizes all that see it. Flourishes of its decorative water feathers slice into its foes.

englishDescription: This Pokémon spurns all but the finest of foods. Its body gives off an herblike scent that bug Pokémon detest.
chineseDescription: 只吃精挑细选过的食物。虫宝可梦很讨厌它身上散发的那种仿佛香草的气味。
japaneseDescription: This Pokémon spurns all but the finest of foods. Its body gives off an herblike scent that bug Pokémon detest.

englishDescription: It entrances female Pokémon with the sweet, alluring scent that wafts from all over its body.
chineseDescription: 会从全身散发出香甜妖艳的气味，令雌性的宝可梦为它神魂颠倒。（雄性的样子）喜欢干净，个性一丝不苟。会让花香包裹全身来治愈周围的宝可梦们。（雌性的样子）
japaneseDescription: It entrances female Pokémon with the sweet, alluring scent that wafts from all over its body.

englishDescription: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread’s strength is the topic of ongoing research.
chineseDescription: 从臀部射出的丝线的强度可以匹敌金属丝。强度的秘密至今仍在被研究中。
japaneseDescription: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread’s strength is the topic of ongoing research.

englishDescription: Spidops covers its territory in tough, sticky threads to set up traps for intruders.
chineseDescription: 会在自己的地盘里布下坚固又黏糊糊的丝线，来当做捕捉入侵者的陷阱。
japaneseDescription: Spidops covers its territory in tough, sticky threads to set up traps for intruders.

englishDescription: It’s highly skilled at a fighting style in which it uses its jumping capabilities to dodge incoming attacks while also dealing damage to opponents.
chineseDescription: 活用跳跃力来闪避攻击，并同时给予对手伤害，是它很擅长的战斗方式。
japaneseDescription: It’s highly skilled at a fighting style in which it uses its jumping capabilities to dodge incoming attacks while also dealing damage to opponents.

englishDescription: It uses its normally folded third set of legs when in Showdown Mode. This places a huge burden on its body, so it can’t stay in this mode for long.
chineseDescription: 进入决战模式时会使用折叠起来的第３双脚，这会给它身体造成很大的负担，因此无法久战。
japaneseDescription: It uses its normally folded third set of legs when in Showdown Mode. This places a huge burden on its body, so it can’t stay in this mode for long.

englishDescription: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.
chineseDescription: 手部的肉球是放电器官。努力用后脚站立起来，然后从手掌释放出电击。
japaneseDescription: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.

englishDescription: Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.
chineseDescription: 使用的格斗技非常独特。会一边用手掌给予打击，一边用肉球释放电击。
japaneseDescription: Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.

englishDescription: Pawmot’s fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.
chineseDescription: 蓬松的体毛是蓄电池。可以储存与电动汽车等量的电力。
japaneseDescription: Pawmot’s fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.

englishDescription: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.
chineseDescription: 无论何时２只待都在一起。会把寻获的食物均分成两半，亲密无间地一起进食。
japaneseDescription: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.

englishDescription: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.
chineseDescription: 不知不觉之间多了个小孩。虽然像一家子一样生活，但３只的关系仍是个迷。（三只家庭）身型大的２只会一边保护孩子一边战斗。对抗强大的对手时会集体出阵。（四只家庭）
japaneseDescription: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.

englishDescription: The yeast in Fidough’s breath is useful for cooking, so this Pokémon has been protected by people since long ago.
chineseDescription: 会在自己体内培育酵母。自古以来便与人类共生，并带来丰富的饮食生活。
japaneseDescription: The yeast in Fidough’s breath is useful for cooking, so this Pokémon has been protected by people since long ago.

englishDescription: The surface of this Pokémon’s skin hardens when exposed to intense heat, and its body has an appetizing aroma.
chineseDescription: 通过香气四溢的体味强烈地刺激对手使其产生饥饿感，来削弱其精力和体力。
japaneseDescription: The surface of this Pokémon’s skin hardens when exposed to intense heat, and its body has an appetizing aroma.

englishDescription: This Pokémon converts nutrients into oil, which it stores in the fruit on its head. It can easily go a whole week without eating or drinking.
chineseDescription: 会把营养转换成油，并储存在头部的果实里。１个星期不吃不喝也无所谓。
japaneseDescription: This Pokémon converts nutrients into oil, which it stores in the fruit on its head. It can easily go a whole week without eating or drinking.

englishDescription: It basks in the sun to its heart’s content until the fruits on its head ripen. After that, Dolliv departs from human settlements and goes on a journey.
chineseDescription: 当头上的果实沐浴了充足的阳光而开始成熟时，它就会远离人烟，踏上旅途。
japaneseDescription: It basks in the sun to its heart’s content until the fruits on its head ripen. After that, Dolliv departs from human settlements and goes on a journey.

englishDescription: This Pokémon drives back enemies by launching its rich, aromatic oil at them with enough force to smash a boulder.
chineseDescription: 会以连岩石都能粉碎的力道把香醇浓郁的油发射出去，击退敌人。
japaneseDescription: This Pokémon drives back enemies by launching its rich, aromatic oil at them with enough force to smash a boulder.

englishDescription: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they’re out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.
chineseDescription: 会根据羽毛的颜色来组队。绿色比其他颜色更易遗传，因此个体数很多。（绿羽毛）个体数位居第二，仅次于绿色的队。非常敌视绿队。（蓝羽毛）为了不被个体数多的队看不起，黄色的怒鹦哥变得越来越有攻击性。（黄羽毛）它们是个体数最少，不喜欢争执的队。但紧急时刻勇猛果敢。（白羽毛）
japaneseDescription: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they’re out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.

englishDescription: The ground scrapes its body as it travels, causing it to leave salt behind. Salt is constantly being created and replenished inside Nacli’s body.
chineseDescription: 由于盐石宝会在走过的地面留下岩盐的颗粒，因此从前就被称为盐路。
japaneseDescription: The ground scrapes its body as it travels, causing it to leave salt behind. Salt is constantly being created and replenished inside Nacli’s body.

englishDescription: It compresses rock salt inside its body and shoots out hardened salt pellets with enough force to perforate an iron sheet.
chineseDescription: 性格健忘。别说自己盐腌的猎物了，连训练家的指示也经常忘记。
japaneseDescription: It compresses rock salt inside its body and shoots out hardened salt pellets with enough force to perforate an iron sheet.

englishDescription: Many Pokémon gather around Garganacl, hoping to lick at its mineral-rich salt.
chineseDescription: 从盐石巨灵身上采集的岩盐富含回复成分，对维持健康很有帮助。
japaneseDescription: Many Pokémon gather around Garganacl, hoping to lick at its mineral-rich salt.

englishDescription: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.
chineseDescription: 会使用操纵火焰的招式，自古以来就一直都是深受人类重视的宝可梦。
japaneseDescription: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.

englishDescription: This Pokémon clads itself in armor that has been fortified by psychic and fire energy, and it shoots blazing fireballs.
chineseDescription: 它会对训练家宣誓忠诚，但为了锻炼超能力能量，会独自反复进行训练。
japaneseDescription: This Pokémon clads itself in armor that has been fortified by psychic and fire energy, and it shoots blazing fireballs.

englishDescription: An old set of armor steeped in grudges caused this Pokémon’s evolution. Ceruledge cuts its enemies to pieces without mercy.
chineseDescription: 它会对训练家宣誓忠诚，一旦发现谁带有敌意，便会二话不说地劈过去。
japaneseDescription: An old set of armor steeped in grudges caused this Pokémon’s evolution. Ceruledge cuts its enemies to pieces without mercy.

englishDescription: It floats using the electricity stored in its body. When thunderclouds are around, Tadbulb will float higher off the ground.
chineseDescription: 会靠储存在体内的电力来浮在空中。出现雷云时能比平时浮得更高。
japaneseDescription: It floats using the electricity stored in its body. When thunderclouds are around, Tadbulb will float higher off the ground.

englishDescription: What appear to be eyeballs are actually organs for discharging the electricity generated by Bellibolt’s belly-button dynamo.
chineseDescription: 看似眼球的部位其实是放电器官，能够用来发射腹部的发电脐所制造的电力。
japaneseDescription: What appear to be eyeballs are actually organs for discharging the electricity generated by Bellibolt’s belly-button dynamo.

englishDescription: These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they’re a popular delicacy.
chineseDescription: 在海岸的悬崖上筑巢。它的巢具有在嘴里蹦跳的神奇口感，因此是受欢迎的珍味佳肴。
japaneseDescription: These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they’re a popular delicacy.

englishDescription: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There’s hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.
chineseDescription: 会把翅膀制造的电储存到喉囊里。由于羽毛所含的油脂非常少，因此它不是很擅长游泳。
japaneseDescription: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There’s hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.

englishDescription: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.
chineseDescription: 群体的凝聚力非常强。为了不被看扁，会露出不悦的表情威慑对手。
japaneseDescription: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.

englishDescription: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.
chineseDescription: 拥有和外表不相称的好心肠。但如果家人受到对手威胁，则会无情地追击并了结对手。
japaneseDescription: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.

englishDescription: To keep enemies away from its territory, it paints markings around its nest using a poisonous liquid that has an acrid odor.
chineseDescription: 凭借与其小小身体不相称的又长又大的门牙和毒唾液来抵抗敌人，保卫自身。
japaneseDescription: To keep enemies away from its territory, it paints markings around its nest using a poisonous liquid that has an acrid odor.

englishDescription: Each Grafaiai paints its own individual pattern, and it will paint that same pattern over and over again throughout its life.
chineseDescription: 使用会因食物种类而变色的唾液，在石头和树上画图来守卫地盘。
japaneseDescription: Each Grafaiai paints its own individual pattern, and it will paint that same pattern over and over again throughout its life.

englishDescription: Not even Bramblin knows where it is headed as it tumbles across the wilderness, blown by the wind. It loathes getting wet.
chineseDescription: 随着风在荒野之间滚动，自己也不知道会滚到哪里去。最讨厌身体被弄得湿答答的。
japaneseDescription: Not even Bramblin knows where it is headed as it tumbles across the wilderness, blown by the wind. It loathes getting wet.

englishDescription: Brambleghast wanders around arid regions. On rare occasions, mass outbreaks of these Pokémon will bury an entire town.
chineseDescription: 会在干燥地带流浪。有极低的概率会大量出现，把一座城镇塞得满满当当。
japaneseDescription: Brambleghast wanders around arid regions. On rare occasions, mass outbreaks of these Pokémon will bury an entire town.

englishDescription: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.
chineseDescription: 看起来像玛瑙水母，其实是截然不同的种类。虽然脚很细，但是跑起来能达到时速５０公里。
japaneseDescription: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.

englishDescription: It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.
chineseDescription: 会用１０根触手缠住敌人并吸取养分来折磨对方。下摆的褶皱是很受欢迎的珍味佳肴。
japaneseDescription: It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.

englishDescription: This Pokémon lives on sheer cliffs. It sidesteps opponents’ attacks, then lunges for their weak spots with its claws.
chineseDescription: 生活在陡峭的悬崖上。会通过侧步来闪避攻击，然后用钳子瞄准对手的要害。
japaneseDescription: This Pokémon lives on sheer cliffs. It sidesteps opponents’ attacks, then lunges for their weak spots with its claws.

englishDescription: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.
chineseDescription: 或许是受辣味成分影响，它的情绪起伏非常剧烈。若不满便会直接咬过去。
japaneseDescription: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.

englishDescription: The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.
chineseDescription: 虽然２颗头的性格迥异，擅长的战斗方式也不同，但战斗时却能默契配合。超级进化后辣味更强了。会挥舞变得像领带的部分狠狠地殴打对手。（超级进化）
japaneseDescription: The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.

englishDescription: It rolls its mud ball around while the energy it needs for evolution matures. Eventually the time comes for it to evolve.
chineseDescription: 会一边滚着泥巴球，一边让进化所需的能量成熟。最终迎接进化的时刻。
japaneseDescription: It rolls its mud ball around while the energy it needs for evolution matures. Eventually the time comes for it to evolve.

englishDescription: An infant sleeps inside the ball. Rabsca rolls the ball soothingly with its legs to ensure the infant sleeps comfortably.
chineseDescription: 为了能让睡在球里面的宝宝睡得更香甜，会用脚转动球，让宝宝感到安心。
japaneseDescription: An infant sleeps inside the ball. Rabsca rolls the ball soothingly with its legs to ensure the infant sleeps comfortably.

englishDescription: It spends its time running around wastelands. If anyone steals its beloved berries, it will chase them down and exact its revenge.
chineseDescription: 会在荒地跑来跑去来度过时间。如果最喜欢的树果被拿走，就会穷追不舍地展开报复。
japaneseDescription: It spends its time running around wastelands. If anyone steals its beloved berries, it will chase them down and exact its revenge.

englishDescription: It emits psychic power from the gaps between its multicolored frills and sprints at speeds greater than 120 mph.
chineseDescription: 会从彩色的褶边的缝隙间释放出精神力量，借此以时速２００公里的速度狂奔。
japaneseDescription: It emits psychic power from the gaps between its multicolored frills and sprints at speeds greater than 120 mph.

englishDescription: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it’s satisfied with the result.
chineseDescription: 会把在矿山找到的金属碎片和道具组合起来，为自己打造称手的锤子。
japaneseDescription: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it’s satisfied with the result.

englishDescription: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other’s hammers by smashing them together.
chineseDescription: 有时会为了收集金属而来到人类居住的地方，在工厂和仓库四处翻找。
japaneseDescription: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other’s hammers by smashing them together.

englishDescription: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.
chineseDescription: 会把技术传授给自己率领的群体里的小锻匠，教它们如何把金属敲打成形。
japaneseDescription: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.

englishDescription: Though it looks like Diglett, Wiglett is an entirely different species. The resemblance seems to be a coincidental result of environmental adaptation.
chineseDescription: 虽与地鼠相似，却是完全不同的种类。据说是为了适应生活环境，才偶然变得相似。
japaneseDescription: Though it looks like Diglett, Wiglett is an entirely different species. The resemblance seems to be a coincidental result of environmental adaptation.

englishDescription: A variety of fish Pokémon, Wugtrio was once considered to be a regional form of Dugtrio.
chineseDescription: 鱼宝可梦的一种。曾经也有人认为它是三地鼠的地区形态。
japaneseDescription: A variety of fish Pokémon, Wugtrio was once considered to be a regional form of Dugtrio.

englishDescription: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.
chineseDescription: 会用胸口的袋子包住食物，然后带回巢里。以弄掉会发出响亮声音的东西为乐。
japaneseDescription: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.

englishDescription: Its water ring is made from seawater mixed with a sticky fluid that Finizen secretes from its blowhole.
chineseDescription: 水环是由从头部的洞冒出的黏胶与海水混合之后制作而成的。
japaneseDescription: Its water ring is made from seawater mixed with a sticky fluid that Finizen secretes from its blowhole.

englishDescription: Its physical capabilities are no different than a Finizen’s, but when its allies are in danger, it transforms and powers itself up.
chineseDescription: 体能与波普海豚差不多，可一旦伙伴陷入了危机，就会变身来提高自己的力量。（平凡形态）会以５０节的游泳速度去救助溺水的人类和宝可梦。是大海的英雄。（全能形态）
japaneseDescription: Its physical capabilities are no different than a Finizen’s, but when its allies are in danger, it transforms and powers itself up.

englishDescription: The steel section is Varoom’s actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.
chineseDescription: 钢铁的身躯才是本体。会贴在岩石上将其成分转换为活动所需的能量。
japaneseDescription: The steel section is Varoom’s actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.

englishDescription: Revavroom viciously threatens others with the sound of its exhaust. It sticks its tongue out from its cylindrical mouth and sprays toxic fluids.
chineseDescription: 用排气的声音猛烈地威吓对手。会从圆筒形的嘴巴吐出舌头并喷洒毒液。
japaneseDescription: Revavroom viciously threatens others with the sound of its exhaust. It sticks its tongue out from its cylindrical mouth and sprays toxic fluids.

englishDescription: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider’s body heat warms Cyclizar’s back and lifts the Pokémon’s spirit.
chineseDescription: 喉部的褶皱储有能量，因此它能够载着人长距离持续奔跑。
japaneseDescription: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider’s body heat warms Cyclizar’s back and lifts the Pokémon’s spirit.

englishDescription: This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It maintains its metal body by consuming iron from the soil.
chineseDescription: 栖息在干燥的沙地上。会以土中铁质为食，来维持由金属构成的身体。
japaneseDescription: This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It maintains its metal body by consuming iron from the soil.

englishDescription: Glimmet’s toxic mineral crystals look just like flower petals. This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder like pollen to protect itself.
chineseDescription: 紧紧贴在洞窟的顶部。它会用充满有毒成分的花苞撞击敌人来自我保护。
japaneseDescription: Glimmet’s toxic mineral crystals look just like flower petals. This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder like pollen to protect itself.

englishDescription: Glimmora’s petals are made of crystallized poison energy. It has recently become evident that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.
chineseDescription: 绽放出大朵由毒成分构成的花。会与晶光芽们互相配合一起击退敌人。花瓣变大并分离开来。会一边保护本体并旋转，一边播撒有毒的碎片。（超级进化）
japaneseDescription: Glimmora’s petals are made of crystallized poison energy. It has recently become evident that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.

englishDescription: This friendly Pokémon doesn’t like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.
chineseDescription: 非常喜欢嬉闹玩耍。会摩擦体毛来吸取对手的精气直至枯竭。
japaneseDescription: This friendly Pokémon doesn’t like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.

englishDescription: A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn’t like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.
chineseDescription: 多年来不断守护与其死别的主人的墓地，在这个过程中转生成了幽灵宝可梦。
japaneseDescription: A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn’t like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.

englishDescription: Thanks to a behavior of theirs known as “synchronizing,” an entire flock of these Pokémon can attack simultaneously in perfect harmony.
chineseDescription: 当规模大时会超过１万只的缠红鹤群体在同步彼此动作时，所呈现出的那幅景象非常壮观。
japaneseDescription: Thanks to a behavior of theirs known as “synchronizing,” an entire flock of these Pokémon can attack simultaneously in perfect harmony.

englishDescription: It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.
chineseDescription: 在寒冷地带会组成约５只的群体来生活。喜欢雪或冰所包含的矿物质。
japaneseDescription: It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.

englishDescription: Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.
chineseDescription: 上颚的角集中了冰之能量，会使其变得超低温，以此来将自己的周围冻结。
japaneseDescription: Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.

englishDescription: Veluza has excellent regenerative capabilities. It sheds spare flesh from its body to boost its agility, then charges at its prey.
chineseDescription: 拥有强大的再生能力。会丢弃身上的赘肉来让自己变得轻盈后再去突击猎物。
japaneseDescription: Veluza has excellent regenerative capabilities. It sheds spare flesh from its body to boost its agility, then charges at its prey.

englishDescription: It treats Tatsugiri like its boss and follows it loyally. Though powerful, Dondozo is apparently not very smart.
chineseDescription: 大闹起来时会引发巨浪。它虽然拥有巨大的身体和惊人的力量，却不擅长捕食。
japaneseDescription: It treats Tatsugiri like its boss and follows it loyally. Though powerful, Dondozo is apparently not very smart.

englishDescription: Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.
chineseDescription: 为了争夺作为搭档的吃吼霸，米立龙之间会展开激烈的战斗。（上弓姿势）就算被敌人整个吞下，也会尝试用鼓起喉囊之类的方法脱身。（下垂姿势）会凭借高智商判断情况，只要发现没有胜算，就会一溜烟地逃跑。（平挺姿势）超级进化使大脑活性化，让它变得更加精明狡猾。会制造并熟练使用分身。（超级进化、上弓姿势）会凝聚超级进化的能量作为溢出的能量射出，一碰到东西就会发生大爆炸。（超级进化、下垂姿势）会用超级进化的能量制成像盘子一样的东西，乘上去后在空中也能自由自在地移动。（超级进化、平挺姿势）
japaneseDescription: Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.

englishDescription: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.
chineseDescription: 多次使出用力到连头上的血管都快要爆裂的招式，然后进化成了弃世猴。
japaneseDescription: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.

englishDescription: It lives at the bottom of ponds and swamps. It will carry Wooper on its back and ferry them across water from one shore to the other.
chineseDescription: 栖息在池塘或沼泽的底部。会让乌波坐在自己背上，然后游着泳把它送到对岸去。
japaneseDescription: It lives at the bottom of ponds and swamps. It will carry Wooper on its back and ferry them across water from one shore to the other.

englishDescription: The hardened head from the tail protects the head of the main body as Farigiraf whips its long neck around to headbutt enemies.
chineseDescription: 以坚硬的尾巴头保护着本体的头，并甩动长长的脖子让对手吃它一记头槌。
japaneseDescription: The hardened head from the tail protects the head of the main body as Farigiraf whips its long neck around to headbutt enemies.

englishDescription: It drives enemies out of its nest by sucking in enough air to fill its long, narrow lungs, then releasing the air in an intense blast.
chineseDescription: 会吸进空气充满细长的肺部，然后掀起强烈的爆炸气浪，将敌人赶出自己的巢穴。（二节形态）最近的研究发现，它的身体会有多少节是由基因决定的。（三节形态）
japaneseDescription: It drives enemies out of its nest by sucking in enough air to fill its long, narrow lungs, then releasing the air in an intense blast.

englishDescription: Though it commands a massive army in battle, it’s not skilled at devising complex strategies. It just uses brute strength to keep pushing.
chineseDescription: 会引领大军来战斗，却不擅长困难的战术，只会用蛮力来压制对手。
japaneseDescription: Though it commands a massive army in battle, it’s not skilled at devising complex strategies. It just uses brute strength to keep pushing.

englishDescription: This creature resembles a mysterious Pokémon that, according to a paranormal magazine, has lived since ancient times.
chineseDescription: 长得就像是超自然杂志曾介绍的自太古以来就存活至今的神秘宝可梦。
japaneseDescription: This creature resembles a mysterious Pokémon that, according to a paranormal magazine, has lived since ancient times.

englishDescription: It resembles a mysterious Pokémon described in a paranormal magazine as a Jigglypuff from one billion years ago.
chineseDescription: 超自然杂志曾将某只神秘的宝可梦介绍为１０亿年前的胖丁，该宝可梦与它长得很相似。
japaneseDescription: It resembles a mysterious Pokémon described in a paranormal magazine as a Jigglypuff from one billion years ago.

englishDescription: It bears a slight resemblance to a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a cross between a dinosaur and a mushroom.
chineseDescription: 可疑的杂志曾介绍过某种恐龙与蘑菇合成的宝可梦，该宝可梦与它有些相似。
japaneseDescription: It bears a slight resemblance to a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a cross between a dinosaur and a mushroom.

englishDescription: It has similar features to a ghostly pterosaur that was covered in a paranormal magazine, but the two have little else in common.
chineseDescription: 它只有特征的部分与超自然杂志曾报道的翼龙的幽灵相似。
japaneseDescription: It has similar features to a ghostly pterosaur that was covered in a paranormal magazine, but the two have little else in common.

englishDescription: This Pokémon somewhat resembles an ancient form of Volcarona that was introduced in a dubious magazine.
chineseDescription: 这只宝可梦与可疑的杂志曾介绍的火神蛾太古时代的样子长得有点像。
japaneseDescription: This Pokémon somewhat resembles an ancient form of Volcarona that was introduced in a dubious magazine.

englishDescription: It slightly resembles a Magneton that lived for 10,000 years and was featured in an article in a paranormal magazine.
chineseDescription: 它与超自然杂志曾报道的活了１万年的三合一磁怪长得稍微有些相似。
japaneseDescription: It slightly resembles a Magneton that lived for 10,000 years and was featured in an article in a paranormal magazine.

englishDescription: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. It resembles a mysterious object described in an old expedition journal.
chineseDescription: 近年有人目击到它。是与古老的探险记中记载的不明物体长得很像的宝可梦。
japaneseDescription: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. It resembles a mysterious object described in an old expedition journal.

englishDescription: It resembles a mysterious object mentioned in an old book. There are only two reported sightings of this Pokémon.
chineseDescription: 与古老的书籍中记载的神秘物体相似的宝可梦。过去只被目击过２次。
japaneseDescription: It resembles a mysterious object mentioned in an old book. There are only two reported sightings of this Pokémon.

englishDescription: This Pokémon shares many similarities with Iron Hands, an object mentioned in a certain expedition journal.
chineseDescription: 这种宝可梦与某本探险记中记载的一种叫做铁臂膀的物体有许多相似之处。
japaneseDescription: This Pokémon shares many similarities with Iron Hands, an object mentioned in a certain expedition journal.

englishDescription: It’s possible that Iron Jugulis, an object described in an old book, may actually be this Pokémon.
chineseDescription: 古老的书籍中所记载的叫做铁脖颈的物体说不定就是这只宝可梦。
japaneseDescription: It’s possible that Iron Jugulis, an object described in an old book, may actually be this Pokémon.

englishDescription: No records exist of this species being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match up with an object described in an old book.
chineseDescription: 没有捕获记录。资料不足。其特征与古老的书籍里所记载的物体一致。
japaneseDescription: No records exist of this species being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match up with an object described in an old book.

englishDescription: Some of its notable features match those of an object named within a certain expedition journal as Iron Thorns.
chineseDescription: 它有一部分特征与某本探险记中介绍的名为铁荆棘的物体一致。
japaneseDescription: Some of its notable features match those of an object named within a certain expedition journal as Iron Thorns.

englishDescription: This Pokémon lives in forests and craggy areas. Using the power of its dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its nest like a refrigerator.
chineseDescription: 背鳍能将火属性招式的热能转换为冰属性的能量并冻结空气。
japaneseDescription: This Pokémon lives in forests and craggy areas. Using the power of its dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its nest like a refrigerator.

englishDescription: It attacks with the blade of its frozen dorsal fin by doing a front flip in the air. Arctibax’s strong back and legs allow it to pull off this technique.
chineseDescription: 用冰之面罩和背鳍的剑来武装自己。会以敏捷的动作扑向对手并进行切斩。
japaneseDescription: It attacks with the blade of its frozen dorsal fin by doing a front flip in the air. Arctibax’s strong back and legs allow it to pull off this technique.

englishDescription: It launches itself into battle by flipping upside down and spewing frigid air from its mouth. It finishes opponents off with its dorsal blade.
chineseDescription: 从嘴里吐出连熔岩都能冻结的冷气，再用尾巴一击粉碎冻住的敌人。背鳍的剑因超级进化而变得更加巨大。它会从上腹部的剑柄发射光束招式进行攻击。（超级进化）
japaneseDescription: It launches itself into battle by flipping upside down and spewing frigid air from its mouth. It finishes opponents off with its dorsal blade.

englishDescription: It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it’s actually a Pokémon.
chineseDescription: 藏身在坚固的宝箱里。虽然拥有很高的防御力，但身体沉重，不擅长移动。（宝箱形态）快要被人类或宝可梦发现时，会只留下硬币，让本体变透明来保护自己。（徒步形态）
japaneseDescription: It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it’s actually a Pokémon.

englishDescription: It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins. Gholdengo overwhelms its enemies by firing coin after coin at them in quick succession.
chineseDescription: 十分喜爱热闹的地方，因此也会有居住在城镇的野生赛富豪。
japaneseDescription: It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins. Gholdengo overwhelms its enemies by firing coin after coin at them in quick succession.

englishDescription: It drains the life-force from vegetation, causing nearby forests to instantly wither and fields to turn barren.
chineseDescription: 吸取草木的能量，使周围的森林瞬间干枯，田地的农作物歉收。
japaneseDescription: It drains the life-force from vegetation, causing nearby forests to instantly wither and fields to turn barren.

englishDescription: The hatred of those who perished by the sword long ago has clad itself in snow and become a Pokémon.
chineseDescription: 很久以前，丧命于剑下者的憎恨之情缠绕在雪上，变成了宝可梦。
japaneseDescription: The hatred of those who perished by the sword long ago has clad itself in snow and become a Pokémon.

englishDescription: It slowly brings its exceedingly heavy head down upon the ground, splitting the earth open with huge fissures that run over 160 feet deep.
chineseDescription: 当它缓缓挥下自己笨重的头部时，会让地面出现深度达５０米的巨大裂缝。
japaneseDescription: It slowly brings its exceedingly heavy head down upon the ground, splitting the earth open with huge fissures that run over 160 feet deep.

englishDescription: The envy accumulated within curved beads that sparked multiple conflicts has clad itself in fire and become a Pokémon.
chineseDescription: 曾引起无数斗争的勾玉聚集了嫉妒之情。这些嫉妒缠绕了火焰，变成了宝可梦。
japaneseDescription: The envy accumulated within curved beads that sparked multiple conflicts has clad itself in fire and become a Pokémon.

englishDescription: According to an article in a dubious magazine, this Pokémon has some connection to a phenomenon that occurs in a certain region.
chineseDescription: 根据可疑杂志的报道所说，这种宝可梦好像跟某个地区会发生的现象有关联。
japaneseDescription: According to an article in a dubious magazine, this Pokémon has some connection to a phenomenon that occurs in a certain region.

englishDescription: It’s possible that this is the object listed as Iron Valiant in a certain expedition journal.
chineseDescription: 它有可能就是某本探险记中记载的名为铁武者的物体。
japaneseDescription: It’s possible that this is the object listed as Iron Valiant in a certain expedition journal.

englishDescription: This Pokémon resembles Cyclizar, but it is far burlier and more ferocious. Nothing is known about its ecology or other features.
chineseDescription: 虽然外观与摩托蜥相似，但却远比后者更为顽强凶暴。有关它的生态等信息一切未明。（完全形态）与古老的书籍所记载的名为翼大王的生物有着相似的特征。（制限形态）
japaneseDescription: This Pokémon resembles Cyclizar, but it is far burlier and more ferocious. Nothing is known about its ecology or other features.

englishDescription: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.
chineseDescription: 它似乎就是古老的书籍中提及的铁大蛇。传说它曾用雷电将大地变为灰烬。（完整模式）密勒顿这个名字是由发现它的博士命名而来。生态等详情尚且不明。（受限模式）
japaneseDescription: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.

englishDescription: It resembles an illustration published in a paranormal magazine, said to be a depiction of a super-ancient Suicune.
chineseDescription: 样子与超自然杂志所刊登的插图中的超古代水君很相似。
japaneseDescription: It resembles an illustration published in a paranormal magazine, said to be a depiction of a super-ancient Suicune.

englishDescription: According to the few eyewitness accounts that exist, it used its shining blades to julienne large trees and boulders.
chineseDescription: 根据极少的目击报告，它用散发着光辉的剑将大树和大石头切成了丝。
japaneseDescription: According to the few eyewitness accounts that exist, it used its shining blades to julienne large trees and boulders.

englishDescription: The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm, while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two share one apple and help each other out.
chineseDescription: 露出脑袋的外头虫与露出尾巴的里头虫互相帮助，一起生活在苹果里面。
japaneseDescription: The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm, while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two share one apple and help each other out.

englishDescription: Poltchageist looks like a regional form of Sinistea, but it was recently discovered that the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.
chineseDescription: 看似是来悲茶的地区形态，但最近被发现其实两者之间毫无关系。（冒牌货的样子）住在昂贵茶罐中的样子。虽然与便宜货不同，但外行人分辨不出来。（高档货的样子）
japaneseDescription: Poltchageist looks like a regional form of Sinistea, but it was recently discovered that the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.

englishDescription: It prefers cool, dark places, such as the back of a shelf or the space beneath a home's floorboards. It wanders in search of prey after sunset.
chineseDescription: 喜欢待在民宅的地板下和架子深处等阴凉的地方。日落后会四处徘徊寻找猎物。（凡作的样子）越是搅拌头上的茶筅就越能补充更多能量。这是进行战斗前的准备。（杰作的样子）
japaneseDescription: It prefers cool, dark places, such as the back of a shelf or the space beneath a home's floorboards. It wanders in search of prey after sunset.

englishDescription: Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper. It can pulverize anything by swinging around the chain on its neck.
chineseDescription: 很容易失去冷静的粗暴家伙。会甩动脖子上的锁链击碎一切。
japaneseDescription: Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper. It can pulverize anything by swinging around the chain on its neck.

englishDescription: Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.
chineseDescription: 会从安全的地方释放出能引起强烈头晕的念力，将敌人玩弄于股掌之间。
japaneseDescription: Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.

englishDescription: Fezandipiti beats its glossy wings to scatter pheromones that captivate people and Pokémon.
chineseDescription: 扇动艳丽的翅膀抛撒费洛蒙让人和宝可梦为其神魂颠倒。
japaneseDescription: Fezandipiti beats its glossy wings to scatter pheromones that captivate people and Pokémon.

englishDescription: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.
chineseDescription: 喜欢恶作剧，好奇心旺盛。会释出蕴藏在面具内的属性的能量战斗。（碧草面具）激发出水之力量的样子。会以踢技和藤蔓发起无间断的打击。（水井面具）激发出火之力量的样子。会像挥动长枪一样操控带刺的藤蔓贯穿敌人。（火灶面具）激发出岩石之力量的样子。能以坚固的岩石身躯抵挡任何攻击，守护自身。（础石面具）
japaneseDescription: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.

englishDescription: It digs holes on mountains, searching for food. It’s so durable that being caught in a cave-in won’t faze it.
chineseDescription: 会在山里挖洞寻找食物。身体坚硬，即使遇到塌方也毫无问题。
japaneseDescription: It digs holes on mountains, searching for food. It’s so durable that being caught in a cave-in won’t faze it.

englishDescription: These capricious syrpents have banded together. On the rare occasion that their moods align, their true power is unleashed.
chineseDescription: 由善变的蛇虫虫们聚集而成。当它们偶尔心意相通时，就会发挥出真正的力量。
japaneseDescription: These capricious syrpents have banded together. On the rare occasion that their moods align, their true power is unleashed.
japaneseGenus: りんごオロチポケモン

englishDescription: It resembles an eerie Pokémon once shown in a paranormal magazine. That Pokémon was said to be an Entei regenerated from a fossil.
chineseDescription: 与超自然杂志所刊登的可疑的宝可梦很相似。该杂志声称那是从化石中复原的炎帝。
japaneseDescription: It resembles an eerie Pokémon once shown in a paranormal magazine. That Pokémon was said to be an Entei regenerated from a fossil.
japaneseGenus: パラドックスポケモン

englishDescription: It bears resemblance to a Pokémon that became a hot topic for a short while after a paranormal magazine touted it as Raikou's ancestor.
chineseDescription: 与超自然杂志报道的曾短暂引起一阵话题的雷公的祖先长得很像。
japaneseDescription: It bears resemblance to a Pokémon that became a hot topic for a short while after a paranormal magazine touted it as Raikou's ancestor.
japaneseGenus: パラドックスポケモン

englishDescription: It was named after a mysterious object recorded in an old book. Its body seems to be metallic.
chineseDescription: 身体似乎是金属质地。名字来自古书中所记载的神秘物体。
japaneseDescription: It was named after a mysterious object recorded in an old book. Its body seems to be metallic.
japaneseGenus: パラドックスポケモン

englishDescription: There was supposedly an incident in which it launched shining blades to cut everything around it to pieces. Little else is known about it.
chineseDescription: 据说它曾经射出发光的刀刃砍断了周围的一切，但无其他信息，身份不明。
japaneseDescription: There was supposedly an incident in which it launched shining blades to cut everything around it to pieces. Little else is known about it.
japaneseGenus: パラドックスポケモン

englishDescription: It’s thought that this Pokémon lived in ancient Paldea until it got caught in seismic shifts and went extinct.
chineseDescription: 人们以前一直认为它们曾生活在古代帕底亚，但因地壳变动影响而灭绝。（普通形态）若太晶的甲壳受到对手招式的攻击，就会将其能量吸收，供自己使用。（太晶形态）跟据古老的探险记记载，它被掩埋在地底的样子就像浮在宇宙的星星一样。（星晶形态）
japaneseDescription: It’s thought that this Pokémon lived in ancient Paldea until it got caught in seismic shifts and went extinct.

englishDescription: Its peach-shaped shell serves as storage for a potent poison. It makes poisonous mochi and serves them to people and Pokémon.
chineseDescription: 桃形的壳是剧毒的储存库。会制作毒粘糕来款待人和宝可梦。
japaneseDescription: Its peach-shaped shell serves as storage for a potent poison. It makes poisonous mochi and serves them to people and Pokémon.
